study: GV1001 extension in progressive supranuclear palsy
assessment: The open-label extension follows a synthetic peptide trial in PSP. No culinary exposure was compared.

study: MASCOT baseline in multiple system atrophy
assessment: The abstract reports baseline characteristics for the amlenetug trial in MSA.

study: South Asian genome-wide study of PSP
assessment: The comparison evaluates inherited variation in PSP. It gives no food or Parkinson symptom estimate.
The extension follows chorea and drug safety in Huntington disease.
Longitudinal speech features are evaluated against Huntington progression. No dietary exposure is reported.

study: Finger tapping severity estimated from movement features
assessment: The abstract validates rating estimates using movement features. It does not evaluate foods.
The analysis compares GCH1 variation and clinical course. No food is analyzed.

study: Korean genome-wide study of idiopathic Parkinson disease
assessment: The abstract reports susceptibility loci. Its disease-risk comparisons are not symptom estimates following intake.
The extension measures tic outcomes and safety with a dopamine receptor antagonist.

study: Accelerometry during sleep and synuclein biomarker status
assessment: Wrist accelerometry and biomarkers were compared in isolated REM sleep behavior disorder and early Parkinson disease. No intake comparison was reported.

study: Parkinson disease and cancer risk in FinnGen
assessment: The linked-record analysis assesses the timing and site of cancer diagnoses. It gives no food-by-symptom estimate.

study: CSF markers of LRRK2 pathway activation
assessment: The abstract compares pathway markers and participant subgroups. No culinary exposure was assessed.

study: Neural transport in the paraquat and lectin rat model
assessment: The report uses a combined toxin and lectin model. The original methods lineage identifies pea lectin. No cooked-pea or human symptom estimate was measured.
The 57-person Parkinson comparison gives an inconclusive motor result and a quality-of-life difference at one year. Individual foods and their effects remain unreported.
The trial evaluated a LRRK2 degrader, eye movements and CSF measures. No food was administered as the tested exposure.
The imaging analysis compared measures of dopaminergic and cholinergic pathways with cognition. It provides no diet data.
The abstract tests gene regulation and pathological markers. No culinary exposure was assessed.
The trial evaluates a glucocerebrosidase activator in GBA-associated Parkinson disease.
The placebo-controlled trial evaluates the LRRK2 inhibitor in early Parkinson disease.
Ferritin and nigral iron were studied as disease markers. Iron intake and food preparation were not examined.
The phase 3 trial evaluated OFF time with solengepras. It did not compare foods.
The phase 2a trial evaluates a synthetic analogue of a licorice constituent. It provides a motor-score result for the drug, with no dietary licorice contrast.
The trial assesses a dual incretin analogue and exploratory extracellular-vesicle biomarkers. Food intake was outside the assigned exposures.

study: Air pollution and cognitive decline in Lewy body disorders
assessment: The exposure was fine particulate air pollution. Cohort and mechanistic analyses give no food comparison.
